title: Permutation Test for a Mean Difference by Hand
learning_objectives: State a null hypothesis as exchangeability
Compute a two-sided permutation p-value with the +1 correction
entry_point: fisher_yates(items, rng); permutation_test(x, y, n_perm=5000, seed=0)
hints: Copy first: `a = list(items)`, then loop `for i in range(len(a) - 1, 0, -1)`.
Split each shuffled pool into `p[:nx]` and `p[nx:]` and compare absolute differences.

failure_feedback.advice: Loop i from n−1 down to 1 and use j = int(rng.random()*(i+1)).
A biased shuffle (j over the whole list) fails this check.
Use abs(d) >= abs(d_obs) − 1e-12 so ties count.
